text:
Ana (PM): Quick sync — customer asks for per-route cost breakdown + trace hooks to debug token-level regressions. Need to decide MVP cuts.
Matt (Eng): Can we do per-route cost in console by aggregating token counts and model version? low-effort vis + small API change.
Jamie (SRE): Tracing hooks: adding span for model_infer + kv_cache_hit would be helpful. sampling concerns at 100qps though.
Alisha (Data): For error analytics we can surface error-class + representative examples, but we need a strict schema for payloads (status, error_code, snippet, stack-ish).
Ana (PM): Customers: FinAppsInc wants SLA + per-customer cost dashboard; MediaCo wants end-to-end trace to find latency spikes tied to model changes.
Matt (Eng): Proposal: Phase 1 = dashboards (per-route cost, p95/p99 latency by model), light tracing (span markers + sample id), and error-summary with examples. Phase 2 = distributed traces + request-level cost drilldown + retrievable raw traces.
Jamie (SRE): Important: tracing must be opt-in per deployment to control overhead. We should support dynamic sampling + a small binary flag that includes KV cache spans.
Alisha (Data): Launch criteria suggestion: (1) per-route cost matches billing within 2% on sampled runs, (2) traces include model span + cache hit flag for >=95% of sampled traces, (3) error analytics surfaces top 5 classes with at least one example per class.
Matt (Eng): Tech note: we can emit structured trace events via existing telemetry pipeline. Example event we can standardize:
```json
{
  "type": "model_infer",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "redwood-1.2",
  "latency_ms": 142,
  "tokens": 64,
  "cache_hit": false,
  " customer_id": "cust-123"
}
```
Ana (PM): UX asks: allow grouping by model, route, and customer; enable filter by time window and tag. Keep initial UI minimal — table + small chart + sample trace viewer.
Jamie (SRE): Risks: cost of storing full traces + PII in trace payloads. Mitigation: store only summary + pointer to raw payload stored in restricted bucket; redact PII at emitter.
Ana (PM): Prioritization question: Should per-customer cost and per-route cost ship together in MVP? multiple customers asked both.
Matt (Eng): My recommendation: include per-route + coarse per-customer aggregate (topline spend), cut detailed per-customer drilldowns from MVP to reduce scope.
Alisha (Data): We'll need a canonical error event schema. I'll draft and share a PR with example mapping to console.
ops-bot: @channel telemetry/trace-schema-v1.json created by Alisha.
Ana (PM): Action items: Matt -> prototype trace emitters & console mock (2w). Jamie -> sampling plan + SLO impact analysis (1w). Alisha -> error schema draft and example queries (3d). Product -> schedule two customer demos next week.
Jamie (SRE): Also need a defined cost signal: estimated_cost = tokens * model_unit_cost + infra_amortized. Need finance to provide model_unit_cost per model family.
Ana (PM): I'll ping finance for model_unit_cost numbers and confirm privacy constraints for customer-level aggregates.
Matt (Eng): One more ask from eng: show an estimated cost-per-request hover in UI (quick calc). Could be a follow-up.
Ana (PM): OK — reconvene Friday 10:00am PT to lock MVP scope. Add blockers here before then.
Jamie (SRE): No infra blockers today. Note: Dedicated clusters may need a small quota bump for sampled trace retention.
Alisha (Data): PR incoming tonight with schema + example dashboard query.
Ana (PM): Thanks all :thumbsup:
